name: Roula AbuGhazaleh
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: I specialise in culturally sensitive counselling focused on boundaries and empowerment, trauma recovery, grief and loss, domestic violence, and problem gambling. I work with individuals and couples facing relationship difficulties, drawing on CBT, ACT, Emotionally Focused Therapy (EFT), and Solution-Focused approaches — always tailored to you, never a one-size-fits-all formula.

name: Anita Khalil
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Welcome to Veritas. I'm Anita, Masters qualified Art Therapist. It also helps to access and resolve trauma held in the body where there are no conscious memories or verbal narrative by focusing on how it is experienced by the body in the present
specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic Experiencing

name: Amelia Martinez-Hillmann
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Relationship, Child, Youth, and Family Therapist with an Integrative, psychoeducational, person-centred and trauma informed approach. With over 15 years experience working with indivuduals, youth and Families in public, community and private practice settings.

name: Eleanor Roche
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: As a trauma therapist and multidisciplinary artist, I work at the intersection of relational healing, psychological sciences, creativity, and cultural identity. My practice supports people navigating trauma, relationship patterns, and disconnection—from themselves, others and what gives them meaning in life; their values. I specialise in working with complex trauma, often rooted in experiences of intimate family violence, cultural rupture and developmental trauma. I use a range of evidence-based and expressive approaches including EMDR, attachment theory, creative arts therapies, reflective writing, and yogic practices. I offer a space where trauma can be safely recognised, processed and healed.

name: Fiona McLauchlan
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: Fiona provides counselling for the emotional aftermath of trauma, relationship harm, family violence, grief, life transitions, and other painful life experiences, while welcoming and respectfully holding your spiritual, faith-based worldview and values. Fiona provides a warm, grounded space to * make sense of what you’ve lived through * rebuild self-trust * strengthen boundaries, and * move forward with greater clarity and choice. When something painful, confusing or destabilising has happened, it can continue to affect * how safe you feel * how you see yourself, and * how you move through relationships, with yourself and others.
specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic Experiencing, Somatic psychotherapy
